tiktok.caption: That 'was $199' price tag? It was never $199. The FTC proved it — and this trick costs you $2,600/year

youtube_short.title: The Fake Sale Price Stealing $2,600/Year
title_alternatives: That 'SALE' Price Was Never Real — $2,600/Year Trap
How Stores Fake 'Original' Prices to Steal Thousands From You
youtube_short.description: Retailers set prices they almost never actually charge — just to slash them and make you feel like you got a deal. The FTC found 85% of 'compare at' prices were never real. Amazon even settled a class action over it in 2022. This psychological trick costs the average shopper $2,600 a year across clothing, electronics, and home goods. Next time you see 'was $199 now $97', check the actual price history first. #finance #moneypsychology #moneytrap #shoppinghacks #personalfinance
